modelPolicy.description: Inherits Phase 5 five-tier routing from harness-kit. Consult skillModelMapping in the harness for per-skill primary models and fallback chains.

graph.localGraphPathsNote: Configure these paths to enable the harness to discover your local knowledge graphs when used as an external tool.

memory.description: When using the harness as an external tool, configure paths where your project stores lessons, briefs, and technique radar entries.

harness.description: Harness infrastructure directories: runs (execution journals), loops (workflow definitions). When using as external tool, configure custom paths if needed.

compaction.description: T3 (anthropic-context-compaction.md): scripts/harness/context-compaction.mjs. run-experiment.mjs keeps the most recent maxRecentIterations one-line history entries verbatim and compacts older ones into a single summary line; plan-review.mjs keeps full critique text for the most recent maxRecentRounds and compacts older rounds to verdict-only lines.

scratchNotes.description: T5 (anthropic-agentic-memory-file-notes.md): opt-in per-run scratch notes file for run-experiment.mjs (--scratch-notes or HARNESS_EXPERIMENT_SCRATCH_NOTES=true). Off by default; kept separate from committed harness memory.

contextGrowth.description: Warn-only prompt-size tripwire (scripts/harness/run-experiment.mjs, scripts/harness/plan-review.mjs). Composed-prompt character count is a rough proxy (~4 chars/token), not a measured token count, since these loops shell out to an arbitrary agent CLI with no token-usage channel. Crossing the threshold only warns and records promptChars; it never blocks a run.
